name: Nadir
description: The point underfoot: the same rings, opened out, with the centre bored away.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 2%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at @pick(28% 28%, 72% 28%, 72% 72%, 28% 72%), #000 0.00% 16.67%, transparent 16.67% 33.33%, #000 33.33% 50.00%, transparent 50.00% 66.67%, #000 66.67% 83.33%, transparent 83.33% 100.00%); mask: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at @pick(28% 28%, 72% 28%, 72% 72%, 28% 72%), #000 0.00% 16.67%, transparent 16.67% 33.33%, #000 33.33% 50.00%, transparent 50.00% 66.67%, #000 66.67% 83.33%, transparent 83.33% 100.00%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
